question: Where can I find fast food restaurant inside 50 kilometers as I travel from Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ toward Preakness healthcare, Wayne, NJ?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_Intersects( geometry, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bayonne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Preakness healthcare%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ) ) :: geography, 50000 ) :: geometry );
